timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Lizzo just responded to the lawsuit, filed by her former dancers.
In an IG post, she called the last few days disappointing and that the allegations are too unbelievable
and outrageous to not be addressed.
She claims that her former employees publicly admitted that the tour behavior was inappropriate
and that she has to make hard decisions as an artist.
She continued to say that she is not the villain and that she would never criticize or terminate
a woman due to her weight.
